rules.x_world_measured: the body (green: torso, legs, tail; no neck or head) centroid back-projected through the frame's camera (manifest) onto the vertical plane of the dog's line Z = -0.30 m; metres along the porch
rules.facing: +1 muzzle (red) left of skull (blue) on screen = toward the door; −1 away
rules.lying: body (green, no head) height, px → metres at its depth, < 0.8 × its standing height (0.60 m)
rules.head_below_back: top of head pixels lower than the 2nd-percentile top of body pixels
rules.state: refuse if facing −1; else lie_down if lying and x_world_measured < 1.6 m; else approach/retreat if |vx| > 0.005 m/frame (x_world_measured) (retreat also needs head below back); else watch
rules.onsets: each state change walked back while the producing movement is active (muzzle turning > 2.5°/frame, body height falling > 2 mm/frame, |vx| > 0.0015 m/frame)

onsets.rule: still lying, the dog more than 15 % taller (metres) than at 26.0 s: the head lifts and turns in
